bans.label: Crystal River's golf cart resolution allows carts up to a point east of US 19. It does not authorize driving along US 19.

unverified: The resolution designates SE 8th Avenue only between SE Governors Boulevard and 250 feet east of US 19. That piece is shorter than the whole street, so it is not painted green.
sources: Crystal River golf cart street resolution https://www.crystalriverfl.org/media/12356

sources.label: Crystal River golf cart street resolution

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.
